changes: Added encrypted, monotonic source-file acknowledgements to durable group-send manifests. Updates reseal only the authenticated manifest with a fresh IV and retain original payload and sealed attachment bytes.

IndexedDB compare-and-swap updates merge concurrent receipts without overwriting another update, never recreate a deleted record, and retain recovery data after stale context, corruption or failed writes.

Startup restoration carries acknowledgements into partial-upload result handling. Already acknowledged source positions are excluded from recovery candidates; an entirely acknowledged partial outcome resolves without another message POST. Recovery entries preserve original source indices.
